messages:
sara: Thanks all — following the incident yesterday where the fallback chain failed under burst load, we need a focused follow-up to close gaps in our postmortem. I sketched a small action plan and test additions. can folks take owners?

michael: I can own the regression suite additions for model-fallback and prefix caching. estimated 2 wks to get tests in CI and a short runbook. filing ticket now.

jess: I will pick up the promptset additions — we should capture the failing convo patterns and a couple synthetic edge cases. will push a PR with examples by EOD Friday.

kevin: I'll handle load tests and chaos drills. want to run a few spindle bursts at 200 qps and KV cache invalidation scenarios. need a window for network chaos.

oncall-bot: Incident follow-up created: https://rwinf/issues/INF-4123 - assignees: michael, jess, kevin

sara: great. michael — include quantized model variants in the regression matrix (they behaved differently yesterday). also add a quick smoke that verifies fallback path returns under 200ms for 95% of requests.

michael: noted. will add a matrix entry for q8/q4 variants and run baseline locally. can we get a permanent perf job on dedicated-capacity so we catch regressions early?

sara: yes — ops, can we add a daily smoke on dedicated? not blocking this sprint but high priority to prevent recurrence.

jess: about promptsets — I'm thinking three buckets: 1) failing customer flows from the incident, 2) adversarial/corner prompts that force context truncation, 3) short-latency prompts to catch slow fallbacks. will map to eval harness.

kevin: for chaos drills, proposal: weekly short-run for 4 weeks with increasing blast radius. start with local KV eviction, then throttled GPU pool, then cross-region failover. document playbook and rollback steps.

michael: timeline check — I can deliver CI tests and baseline results in 10 business days (ticket INF-4128). jess ETA Friday for promptset PR (INF-4130). kevin — do you want a dry run next Tue?

kevin: Tue dry run works. I'll coordinate with infra for a maintenance window. will put up a calendar invite.

sara: assigning hard deadlines: regression CI in 10 days, promptsets PR by Friday, chaos drill dry run Tue, final verification and close-out in 3 weeks. I'll own tracking in the postmortem doc and ping weekly.

jess: tagging the new prompt patterns in evals repo: https://github.com/redwood/evals/pull/782 (draft).

michael: added a Jenkins job snippet to the ticket: ```
# jobs/regression/fallback-matrix
matrix: [model_variant, seq_len]
script: run_fallback_tests.sh --variant $model_variant --len $seq_len
```

kevin: I'll add loadrunner configs and schedule the chaos steps in my ticket INF-4132. also recommend adding an alert on fallback-error-rate > 0.5% during bursts.

oncall-bot: Reminder: postmortem action INF-4123 updated by sara at 1769999000

sara: thanks everyone. last ask — whoever lands tests, add a small checklist in the postmortem: how to reproduce, expected results, owners, and a verification checkbox so PMs can sign off. we'll reconvene in 7 days to review progress. :thumbsup:
